G5456.def:
**φωνή**, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for קוֹל ;]
**a voice**;
(a) prop., of persons, [[Mat.2.18|Mat.2:18]] (LXX), al.; φ. αἴρειν (ἐπαίρειν), [[Luk.17.13|Luk.17:13]], [[Act.2.14|Act.2:14]], al.; φ. μεγάλῃ εἰπεῖν (λέγειν, φωνεῖν, etc.), [[Luk.8.28|Luk.8:28]], [[Act.7.57|Act.7:57]], [[Rev.5.12|Rev.5:12]], al.; γίνεται (ἔρχεται) φ. ἐκ τ. οὐρανῶν (ἐξ οὐρανοῦ), [[Mrk.1.11|Mrk.1:11]], [[Luk.3.22|Luk.3:22]], [[Jhn.12.28|Jhn.12:28]], al. (cf. _DCG_, ii, 810a; Dalman, _Words_, 204f.); ἀκούειν φωνήν (-ῆς; see: ἀκούω), [[Act.9.4|Act.9:4]], 7 al.; φ. βοῶντος, [[Mat.3.3|Mat.3:3]], [[Mrk.1.3|Mrk.1:3]], [[Luk.3.4|Luk.3:4]], [[Jhn.1.23|Jhn.1:23]]" (LXX) ; τ. θεοῦ, [[Jhn.5.37|Jhn.5:37]], [[Heb.3.7|Heb.3:7]], al. By meton.,
(α) of the speaker, βλέπειν τὴν φ., [[Rev.1.12|Rev.1:12]]
(β) **speech, language** ( [[Gen.11.1|Gen.11:1]], [[4Ma.12.7|4Ma.12:7]], al.): [[1Co.14.10|1Co.14:10]];
(b) **of inanimate things**: [[Mat.24.31|Mat.24:31]], [[Jhn.3.8|Jhn.3:8]], [[Act.2.6|Act.2:6]], [[Rev.1.15|Rev.1:15]]b 9:9 14:2, al. (cf. Tr., _Syn._, §lxxxix).
(AS)

G5495.def:
**χείρ**, genitive, χειρος (accusative, χεῖραν, [[1Pe.5.6|1Pe.5:6]] T), ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for יָד ;]
**the hand**: [[Mat.3.12|Mat.3:12]], [[Mrk.3.1|Mrk.3:1]], [[Luk.6.6|Luk.6:6]], al. mult.; ἡ χ., acting subject, [[Luk.22.21|Luk.22:21]] pl., [[Act.17.25; 20.34|Act.17:25 20:34]], [[1Jn.1.1|1Jn.1:1]]; τ. ἔργα τῶν χ., [[Act.7.41|Act.7:41]], [[Rev.9.20|Rev.9:20]]; ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τ. ἐμῇ χ., [[1Co.16.21|1Co.16:21]], [[Col.4.18|Col.4:18]], [[2Th.3.17|2Th.3:17]]; prepositional phrases, esp. those without art., similar to Heb. constructions (Bl., §32, 4; 40, 9; 46, 9), ἐν χ.; with genitive (Lft., in l.), [[Gal.3.19|Gal.3:19]] σὺν χ. ἀγγέλου, [[Act.7.35|Act.7:35]] διὰ (τῶν) χειρῶν (διὰ χειρός), [[Mrk.6.2|Mrk.6:2]], [[Act.5.12; 7.25|Act.5:12 7:25]], al.; ἐπὶ χειρῶν, [[Mat.4.6|Mat.4:6]], [[Luk.4.11|Luk.4:11]]; ellipse of χ. (ἡ δεξία, ἀριστερα; Bl., §44, 1), [[Mat.6.3|Mat.6:3]], al. By meton., for the power or activity of an individual, [[Mat.17.22|Mat.17:22]], [[Mrk.9.31|Mrk.9:31]], [[Luk.9.31|Luk.9:31]], [[Jhn.10.39|Jhn.10:39]], [[Act.12.11|Act.12:11]], al.; metaphorically, of the activity or power of God: [[Luk.1.66; 23.46|Luk.1:66 23:46]], [[Jhn.10.29|Jhn.10:29]], [[Act.11.21; 13.11|Act.11:21 13:11]], al.
(AS)

G5457.def:
**φῶς** (Att.. contr. from φάος; φάω), genitive, φωτός, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for אוֹר ;]
**light **(opposite to τὸ σκότος, ἡ σκοτία): [[Mat.17.2|Mat.17:2]], 5, [[Jhn.11.9-10|Jhn.11:9-10]], [[2Co.4.6|2Co.4:6]]; ἡλίου, [[Rev.22.5|Rev.22:5]] of a lamp, [[Luk.8.16; 11.33|Luk.8:16 11:33]], [[Jhn.5.35|Jhn.5:35]], [[Rev.18.23|Rev.18:23]]; of a supernatural heavenly light, [[Act.9.3; 12.7; 22.6, 9; 22.11; 26.13|Act.9:3 12:7 22:6, 9 22:11 26:13]]; hence, ἄγγελος φωτός, [[2Co.11.14|2Co.11:14]] ὁ κλήρος τ. ἁγίων ἐν τ. φ., [[Col.1.12|Col.1:12]] of the divine glory, [[Rev.21.24|Rev.21:24]] by meton., of that which gives light: of fire, [[Mrk.14.54|Mrk.14:54]], [[Luk.22.56|Luk.22:56]] (cl.; [[1Ma.12.29|1Ma.12:29]] cf. _DCG_, i, 595; pl., of a lamp or torch, [[Act.16.29|Act.16:29]] of heavenly bodies, [[Jas.1.17|Jas.1:17]]
Metaphorical,
(a) **of God**: [[1Jn.1.5|1Jn.1:5]] [[Jhn.1.7|Jn 1:7]]; φῶς οἰκῶν ἀπρόσιτον, [[1Ti.6.16|1Ti.6:16]]
(b) **of spiritual truth and its effects on the lives of men**: [[Mat.4.16; 5.16|Mat.4:16 5:16]], [[Jhn.1.4-5; 3.19-21|Jhn.1:4-5 3:19-21]], [[Act.26.18, 23|Act.26:18, 23]], [[2Co.6.14|2Co.6:14]], [[Eph.5.13|Eph.5:13]], [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]], [[1Jn.2.8|1Jn.2:8]]; τ. φ. τ. ζωῆς, [[Jhn.8.12|Jhn.8:12]] τ. ὅπλα τοῦ φ., [[Rom.13.12|Rom.13:12]] καρπὸς τοῦ φ., [[Eph.5.9|Eph.5:9]] έν τ. φ. περιπατεῖν (εἶναι, μένειν), [[1Jn.1.7|1Jn.1:7]] [[Jhn.2.9-10|Jn 2:9-10]]; υἱοὶ (τέκνα) τοῦ φ., [[Luk.16.8|Luk.16:8]], [[Jhn.12.36|Jhn.12:36]], [[Eph.5.8|Eph.5:8]], [[1Th.5.5|1Th.5:5]]; by meton., of one from whom truth shines forth: [[Act.13.47|Act.13:47]] (LXX), [[Rom.2.19|Rom.2:19]] esp. of Christ, [[Luk.2.32|Luk.2:32]], [[Jhn.1.7-8; 12.35-36, 46|Jhn.1:7-8 12:35-36, 46]]; τ. φ. τ. κόσμου, [[Jhn.8.12; 9.5|Jhn.8:12 9:5]];τ. φ. τ. ἀληθινόν, [[Jhn.1.9|Jhn.1:9]] of Christians, [[Mat.5.14|Mat.5:14]], [[Eph.5.8|Eph.5:8]];
(with) **of the spiritual under­standing**: τ. φ. τὸ ἐν σοί, [[Mat.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[Luk.11.35|Luk.11:35]];
(d) **adverbially, of that which is open to view **(opposite to ἐν τ. σκοτίᾳ): ἐν τ. φ., [[Mat.10.27|Mat.10:27]], [[Luk.12.3|Luk.12:3]].†
_SYN._: see: φέγγος (AS)

G5407.def:
**φονεύω**
(φονεύς), [in LXX chiefly for רָצַח ;]
to kill, murder. absol., [[Mat.5.21|Mat.5:21]], [[Jas.4.2|Jas.4:2]]; μὴ (οὐ) φονεύσῃς (-εις), [[Mat.5.21; 19.18|Mat.5:21 19:18]], [[Mrk.10.19|Mrk.10:19]], [[Luk.18.20|Luk.18:20]], [[Rom.13.9|Rom.13:9]], [[Jas.2.11|Jas.2:11]] (all from [[Exo.20.13-14|Exo.20:13-14]]); with accusative, [[Mat.23.31, 35|Mat.23:31, 35]], [[Jas.5.6|Jas.5:6]].†
(AS)

G5438.def:
**φυλακή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(φυλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת and cogn. forms, also for כֶּלֶא etc. ;]
(a) **actively, a guarding, guard, watch **(Hom., Plat., Xen., al.): cogn. accusative, φυλάσσειν φυλακάς, to keep watch, [[Luk.2.8|Luk.2:8]]
(b) of those who keep watch (as also Lat. custodia), a guard; pl., **sentinels, a guard **(Hom., al.): [[Act.12.10|Act.12:10]]
(with) **of the place where persons are kept under guard, a prison **(Hdt., Thuc., al.): [[Mat.14.10|Mat.14:10]], [[Mrk.6.17|Mrk.6:17]], [[Luk.3.20|Luk.3:20]], [[Act.5.19|Act.5:19]], [[2Co.6.5|2Co.6:5]], [[1Pe.3.19|1Pe.3:19]], [[Rev.18.2|Rev.18:2]], al.;
(d) of the time during which guard was kept by night (Lest. vigilia; Anthol.), **a watch**: [[Mat.14.25; 24.43|Mat.14:25 24:43]], [[Mrk.6.48|Mrk.6:48]], [[Luk.12.38|Luk.12:38]]
(AS)

G5460.def:
**φωτεινός (WH**, φωτινός), ή, όν
(φῶς), [in LXX: [[Sir.17.31; 23.19|Sir.17:31 23:19]] * ;]
**bright, light**: νεφέλη, [[Mat.17.5|Mat.17:5]] opposite to σκοτεινός, [[Mat.6.22|Mat.6:22]], [[Luk.11.34, 36|Luk.11:34, 36]].†
(AS)

G5429.def:
**φρόνιμος**, -ον
(φρονέω), [in LXX for בִּין, חָכָם etc. ;]
**practically wise, sensible, prudent**: [[Mat.10.16; 24.45|Mat.10:16 24:45]], [[Luk.12.42|Luk.12:42]], [[1Co.10.15|1Co.10:15]]; opposite to μωρός, [[Mat.7.24; 25.2, 4; 25.8-9|Mat.7:24 25:2, 4 25:8-9]], [[1Co.4.10|1Co.4:10]]; to ἄφρων, [[2Co.11.19|2Co.11:19]] φ. παρ᾽ ἑαυτῷ (EV, wise in one's own conceit), [[Rom.11.25; 12.16|Rom.11:25 12:16]] (cf. [[Pro.3.7|Pro.3:7]]); compar., -ώτερος, [[Luk.16.8|Luk.16:8]]†
_SYN._: see: σοψός (AS)

G5467.def:
**χαλεπός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: [[Isa.18.2|Isa.18:2]] (יָרֵא), [[Wis.3.19|Wis.3:19]], [[Sir.3.21|Sir.3:21]], al. ;]
**hard**;
(a) **hard to do or deal with, difficult**;
(b) **hard to bear, painful, grievous**: καιροί, [[2Ti.3.1|2Ti.3:1]]
(with) **of persons, hard to deal with, harsh, fierce, savage**: [[Mat.8.28|Mat.8:28]]†
(AS)

G5475.def:
**χαλκός**, -oῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for נְחֹשֶׁת ;]
**copper**: [[1Co.13.1|1Co.13:1]], [[Rev.18.12|Rev.18:12]]; by meton., of copper coin, [[Mat.10.9|Mat.10:9]], [[Mrk.6.8; 12.41|Mrk.6:8 12:41]].†
(AS)

G5409.def:
**φορέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Pro.16.23|Pro.16:23]] (יָסַף hi.), [[Sir.11.5|Sir.11:5]], al. ;]
frequent. of φέρω, denoting repeated or habitual action (cf. Tr., _Syn._, § lviii), most commonly used of clothing, weapons, etc., **to bear constantly, wear**: [[Mat.11.8|Mat.11:8]], [[Jhn.19.5|Jhn.19:5]], [[Rom.13.4|Rom.13:4]], [[1Co.15.49|1Co.15:49]], [[Jas.2.3|Jas.2:3]].†
(AS)

G5412.def:
**φορτίζω**
(φόρτος), [in LXX: [[Ezk.16.33|Eze.16:33]] (שָׁחַד) * ;]
**to load**: with dupl. accusative, [[Luk.11.46|Luk.11:46]] pass., **to be laden**: metaphorically (EV, heavy laden), [[Mat.11.28|Mat.11:28]]†
(AS)

G5413.def:
**φορτίον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of φόρτος), [in LXX chiefly for מַשָּׂא ;]
**a burden, load**: of the cargo of a ship (Hdt., al.), [[Act.27.10|Act.27:10]] metaphorically, [[Mat.11.30; 23.4|Mat.11:30 23:4]], [[Luk.11.46|Luk.11:46]], [[Gal.6.5|Gal.6:5]].†
_SYN._: βάρος (which see), ὄγκος (AS)

G5401.def:
**φόβος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for יִרְאָה, also for פַּחַד, אֵימָה, etc. ;]
1. in Hom., flight.
2. **That which causes flight, fear, dread, terror**: [[Luk.1.12|Luk.1:12]], [[Act.5.5|Act.5:5]], [[1Ti.5.20|1Ti.5:20]] [[1Jn.4.18|1Jn.4:18]], al.; cogn. accusative, φοβεῖσθαι φ., [[Mrk.4.41|Mrk.4:41]], [[Luk.2.9|Luk.2:9]]; with genitive obj., [[Jhn.7.13; 19.33; 20.19|Jhn.7:13 19:33 20:19]], [[Heb.2.5|Heb.2:5]], [[1Pe.3.14|1Pe.3:14]] (but cf. _ICC_, in l);ἀπὸ (τοῦ) φ., [[Mat.14.26|Mat.14:26]], [[Luk.21.26|Luk.21:26]]; εἰς φ., [[Rom.8.15|Rom.8:15]] μετὰ φόβου, [[Mat.28.8|Mat.28:8]] φ. καὶ τρόμος (Lft., _Notes_, 172), [[1Co.2.3|1Co.2:3]], [[2Co.7.15|2Co.7:15]], [[Eph.6.5|Eph.6:5]], [[Php.2.12|Php.2:12]]; by meton., of that which causes fear, [[Rom.13.3|Rom.13:3]] of reverential fear, [[Rom.13.7|Rom.13:7]], [[1Pe.1.17; 2.18; 3.2; 3.15|1Pe.1:17 2:18 3:2 3:15]]; τ. κυρίου, [[Act.9.31|Act.9:31]], [[2Co.5.11|2Co.5:11]] (see Field, _Notes_, 183); Χριστοῦ, [[Eph.5.21|Eph.5:21]] θεοῦ, [[Rom.3.18|Rom.3:18]], [[2Co.7.1|2Co.7:1]]
_SYN._: see: δειλία (and of. _DCG_, i, 381) (AS)

G5491.def:
**χεῖλος**, -ους, τό, genitive pl., -εων (see Bl., § 8, 4; Thackeray, _Gr._, I, 151),
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂפָה ;]
**a lip **(as in _Heb._, of the lip as the organ of speech): [[Mat.15.8|Mat.15:8]], [[Mrk.7.6|Mrk.7:6]], [[Rom.3.13|Rom.3:13]], [[1Co.14.21|1Co.14:21]], [[Heb.13.15|Heb.13:15]], [[1Pe.3.10|1Pe.3:10]]" (LXX) . Metaphorical, of things, an edge, brink, etc. (Hom., Hdt., al.): of the sea­shore, [[Heb.11.12|Heb.11:12]]†
(AS)

G5451.def:
**φυτεία**, -ας, ἡ
(φυτεύω), [in LXX: [[2Ki.19.29|4Ki.19:29]] (נָטַע), [[Mic.1.6|Mic.1:6]], [[Ezk.17.7|Eze.17:7]] (מַטָּע) * ;]
1. a planting (Xen., al.; LXX).
2. **= φύτευμα, that which is planted, a plant **(Inscr.): [[Mat.15.13|Mat.15:13]]†
(AS)

G5452.def:
**φυτεύω**
(φυτόν, a plant, φύω), [in LXX chiefly for נָטַע, also for שָׁתַל, etc. ;]
**to plant**: [[Luk.17.28|Luk.17:28]], [[1Co.3.6-8|1Co.3:6-8]]; with accusative, φυτείαν, [[Mat.15.13|Mat.15:13]] ἀμπελῶνα, [[Mat.21.33|Mat.21:33]], [[Mrk.12.1|Mrk.12:1]], [[Luk.20.9|Luk.20:9]], [[1Co.9.7|1Co.9:7]]; pass., before ἐν, [[Luk.13.6; 17.6|Luk.13:6 17:6]].†
(AS)

G5419.def:
**φράζω **
[in LXX: [[Job.6.24|Job.6:24]] (בִּין hi.) [[Job.12.8|Job.12:8]] (יָרָה hi.), Dan LXX 2:4 (חָוָה pa.) * ;]
**to show forth, tell, declare, explain**: [[Mat.13.36|Mat.13:36]] (WH, RV, διασάφησον) [[Mat.15.15|Mat.15:15]]†
(AS)

G5494.def:
**χειμών**, -ῶνος, ὁ
[in LXX for גֶּשֶׁם, סְתָו ;]
1. **winter**: [[Jhn.10.22|Jhn.10:22]], [[2Ti.4.21|2Ti.4:21]]; genitive, χειμῶνος, in winter, [[Mat.24.20|Mat.24:20]], [[Mrk.13.18|Mrk.13:18]].
2. Prop., a winter storm, hence, generally, **a storm, tempest**: [[Mat.16.3|Mat.16:3]] (T, WH, R, mg., om.), [[Act.27.20|Act.27:20]]†
(AS)

G5426.def:
**φρονέω**, -ῶ
(φρήν), [in LXX: [[Deu.32.29|Deu.32:29]], [[Zec.9.2|Zec.9:2]] (חָכָם), [[Psa.94.8|Psa.94:8]] (שָׂכַל hi.), [[Isa.44.18|Isa.44:18]] (בִּין) [[Isa.44.28|Isa.44:28]], [[Est.8.13|Est.8:13]], [[Wis.1.1; 14.30|Wis.1:1 14:30]], [[1Ma.10.20|1Ma.10:20]], [[2Ma.9.12|2Ma.9:12]]; [[2Ma.14.8|2Ma.14:8]] [[2Mac.14.26|2Mac 14:26]] * ;]
1. to have understanding (Hon., al.).
2. **to think, to be minded in a certain way**: ὡς νήπιος, [[1Co.13.11|1Co.13:11]] with accusative (usually neut., adj., or pron., as frequently in cl.), ὃ δεῖ, [[Rom.12.3|Rom.12:3]] ἃ, [[Act.28.22|Act.28:22]] τοῦτο, [[Php.3.15|Php.3:15]] τι ἑτέρως, ib.; οὐδὲν ἄλλο, [[Gal.5.10|Gal.5:10]] τ. αὐτὸ φ. (Deiss., BS, 256), to be of the same mind, [[2Co.13.11|2Co.13:11]], [[Php.2.2; 4.2|Php.2:2 4:2]]; id. before εἰς (ἐν) ἀλλήλους(οις), [[Rom.12.16; 15.5|Rom.12:16 15:5]]; τ. ἓν φ., [[Php.2.2|Php.2:2]] (Lft., in l); before ὑπέρ, [[Php.1.7|Php.1:7]]
3. **to have in mind, be mindful of, think of **(Hdt., Xen., al.; Es, 1Mac, ll. with): τὰ τ. θεοῦ, opposite to τ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, [[Mat.16.23|Mat.16:23]], [[Mrk.8.33|Mrk.8:33]]; τὰ τ. σαρκός, opposite to τ. τ. πνεύρατος, [[Rom.8.5|Rom.8:5]] τ. ἐπίγεια, [[Php.3.19|Php.3:19]] τὰ ἄνω, opposite to τ. ἐπὶ τ. γῆς, [[Col.3.2|Col.3:2]] τοῦτο φρονεῖτε (RV, have this mind in you), [[Php.2.5|Php.2:5]] ὑψηλά, [[Rom.12.16|Rom.12:16]] φ. ἡμέραν (to observe a day), [[Rom.14.6|Rom.14:6]] before ὑπέρ, [[Php.4.10|Php.4:10]] (cf. κατα-, παρα-, περι-, ὑπερ-φρσνέω).†
(AS)

G5442.def:
**φυλάσσω **
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שָׁמַר, also for נָצַר, etc. ;]
**to guard, watch**;
(a) **to guard or watch**: with cogn. accusative, φυλακάς, [[Luk.2.8|Luk.2:8]] with accusative of person(s), [[Act.12.4; 28.16|Act.12:4 28:16]]; pass., [[Luk.8.29|Luk.8:29]], [[Act.23.35|Act.23:35]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.22.20|Act.22:20]]
(b) **to guard or protect**: with accusative, [[Luk.11.21|Luk.11:21]], [[Jhn.12.25; 17.12|Jhn.12:25 17:12]], [[2Th.3.3|2Th.3:3]], [[1Ti.6.20|1Ti.6:20]], [[2Ti.1.12; 1.14|2Ti.1:12 1:14]], [[2Pe.2.5|2Pe.2:5]]; ἑαυτὸν ἀπό, [[1Jn.5.21|1Jn.5:21]] (Westc., in l); metaphorically of law, precept, etc., **to keep, preserve, observe**: [[Mat.19.20|Mat.19:20]], [[Luk.11.28; 18.21|Luk.11:28 18:21]], [[Jhn.12.47|Jhn.12:47]], [[Act.7.53; 16.4; 21.24|Act.7:53 16:4 21:24]], [[Rom.2.26|Rom.2:26]], [[Gal.6.13|Gal.6:13]], [[1Ti.5.21|1Ti.5:21]]. Mid., to be on one's guard (against), **keep oneself from, beware of**: with accusative, [[Act.21.25|Act.21:25]], [[2Ti.4.15|2Ti.4:15]]; before ἀπό., [[Luk.12.15|Luk.12:15]] ἵνα μή, [[2Pe.3.17|2Pe.3:17]] as in LXX ([[Exo.12.17|Exo.12:17]], [[Lev.18.4|Lev.18:4]], al.), of laws, etc., **to keep, observe**: ταῦτα πάντα, [[Mrk.10.20|Mrk.10:20]] (cf. δια-φυάσσω).†
_SYN._: τηρέω, q.v (AS)

G5443.def:
**φυλή**, ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for; מַטֶּה, also for שֵׁבֶט, מִשְׁפָּחָה, etc. ;]
**a body of men united by kinship or habitation, a clan or tribe**: of the tribes of Israel, [[Mat.19.28|Mat.19:28]], [[Luk.2.36; 22.30|Luk.2:36 22:30]], [[Act.13.21|Act.13:21]], [[Rom.11.1|Rom.11:1]], [[Php.3.5|Php.3:5]], [[Heb.7.13-14|Heb.7:13-14]], [[Jas.1.1|Jas.1:1]], [[Rev.5.5; 7.4-8; 21.12|Rev.5:5 7:4-8 21:12]]; of the tribes of the earth, the peoples and nations, [[Mat.24.30|Mat.24:30]], [[Rev.1.7; 5.9; 7.9; 11.9; 13.7; 14.6|Rev.1:7 5:9 7:9 11:9 13:7 14:6]].†
(AS)

G5455.def:
**φωνέω**, -ῶ
(φωνή), [in LXX for קָרָא ([[Jer.17.11|Jer.17:11]], al.), etc. ;]
I. Intrans.
1. **Of persons, to call out, cry out, speak aloud**: [[Luk.8.8|Luk.8:8]] φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, [[Mrk.1.26|Mrk.1:26]], [[Act.16.28|Act.16:28]]; ἐφώνησε (φωνῇ μεγάλῇ) λέγων, [[Luk.8.54|Luk.8:54]], [[Rev.14.18|Rev.14:18]]; φωνήσαντες ἐπύθοντο, [[Act.10.18|Act.10:18]]
2. Of the cries of animals (rarely in cl.; [[Isa.38.14|Isa.38:14]], Je, l.with): of a cock, to crow, [[Mat.26.34|Mat.26:34]], [[Mrk.14.30|Mrk.14:30]], [[Luk.22.3|Luk.22:3]], [[Jhn.13.38; 18.27|Jhn.13:38 18:27]].
II. Trans. (in cl. chiefly poët.), with accusative of person(s), **to call, summon, invite**: [[Mat.20.32; 27.47|Mat.20:32 27:47]], [[Mrk.9.35; 10.49; 15.35|Mrk.9:35 10:49 15:35]], [[Luk.14.12; 16.2; 19.15|Luk.14:12 16:2 19:15]], [[Jhn.1.49; 2.9; 4.16; 10.3; 11.28; 12.17; 18.33|Jhn.1:49 2:9 4:16 10:3 11:28 12:17 18:33]], [[Act.9.41; 10.7|Act.9:41 10:7]]; to address, call by name (Soph.), [[Jhn.13.13|Jhn.13:13]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐπι-, προσ-, συν-φωνέω).†
(AS)

G5418.def:
**φραγμός**, -oῦ, ὁ
(φράσσω), [in LXX chiefly for גָּדֵר, גְּדֵרָה, also for גְּדֵרָה, etc. ;]
1. prop., a fencing in (Soph., OT, 1387).
2. **= φράγμα, a fence**: [[Mat.21.33|Mat.21:33]], [[Mrk.12.1|Mrk.12:1]], [[Luk.14.23|Luk.14:23]]. Metaphorical, μεσότοιχον (which see) τοῦ φ., genitive epexeg., [[Eph.2.14|Eph.2:14]] (see Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

G5440.def:
**φυλακτήριον**, -ου, τό
1. an outpost, fortification (Thuc., al.).
2. a safeguard (Plat.).
3. **an amulet **(Plut., al.); in NT for the Talmudic תְּפִלִּין, a prayer fillet, a phylactery, a small strip of parchment on which portions of the law were written and worn on the forehead and next the heart (cf. [[Exo.13.16|Exo.13:16]]): [[Mat.23.5|Mat.23:5]].†
(AS)

G5437.def:
**φυγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(φεύγω), [in LXX chiefly for מָנוֹס and cogn. forms ;]
**flight**: [[Mat.24.20|Mat.24:20]]†
(AS)

G5473.def:
**χαλκίον**, -ου, τό
(χαλκός), [in LXX: [[Job.41.22|Job.41:22]](23) (סִיר), etc. ;]
a brazen (copper) vessel: [[Mrk.7.4|Mrk.7:4]]†
(AS)

G5499.def:
**χειρο-ποίητος**, -ον
(χείρ, ποιέω), [in LXX (of idols) for אֱלִיל ;]
**made by hand **(i.e. of human handiwork): of temples, [[Mrk.14.58|Mrk.14:58]], [[Act.7.48; 17.24|Act.7:48 17:24]], [[Heb.9.11, 24|Heb.9:11, 24]]; of circumcision, [[Eph.2.11|Eph.2:11]]†
(AS)

G5428.def:
**φρόνησις**, -εως, ἡ
(φρονέω), [in LXX for בִּינָה, תָּבוּן, חׇכְמָה, etc. ;]
**understanding, practical wisdom, prudence**: [[Luk.1.17|Luk.1:17]], [[Eph.1.8|Eph.1:8]].†
_SYN._: see: σοφία, and cf. Lft., _Notes_, 317 (AS)

G5487.def:
**χαριτόω**, -ῶ
(χάρις), [in LXX: [[Sir.18.17|Sir.18:17]] (ἀνδρί κεχαριτωμένῳ; Vg., justificato; Syr., saintly) * ;]
to endow with χάρις (which see), i.e.
1. (a) to make graceful;
(b) to make gracious (Sir, l.with).
2. In Hellenistic writings (for exx., see AR, _Eph._, 227; Lft., _Notes_, 315),
(a) **to cause to find favour**;
(b) **to endue with grace **(i.e. divine favour): [[Luk.1.28|Luk.1:28]], [[Eph.1.6|Eph.1:6]].†
(AS)

G5485.def:
**χάρις, -ιτος, ἡ Abbott-Smith does not include the article here.**, accusative, χάριν (χάριτα in [[Act.24.27|Act.24:27]], [[Jude.4|Ju 4]]; see WH, _App._, 157),
[in LXX chiefly for חֵן ;]
1. objectively, that which causes favourable regard, **gracefulness, grace, loveliness** of form, **graciousness** of speech (cl.; [[Ecc.10.12|Ecc.10:12]], [[Sir.21.16|Sir.21:16]], al.): [[Col.4.6|Col.4:6]]; λόγοι τ. χάριτος (genitive qual.), [[Luk.4.22|Luk.4:22]]
2. Subjectively,
(a) on the part of the giver, **grace, graciousness, kindness, goodwill, favour**: [[Luk.2.52|Luk.2:52]], [[Act.7.10|Act.7:10]], al.; esp. in NT of the divine **favour, grace**, with emphasis on its freeness and universality: [[Luk.1.30|Luk.1:30]], [[Act.14.26|Act.14:26]], [[Rom.1.7|Rom.1:7]], [[1Co.1.3|1Co.1:3]], al.; opposite to ὀφείλημα, [[Rom.4.4, 16|Rom.4:4, 16]]; to ἔργα, [[Rom.11.6|Rom.11:6]]
(b) on the part of the receiver, a sense of favour received, **thanks, gratitude**: [[Rom.6.17; 7.25|Rom.6:17 7:25]], al.; χ. ἔχειν, **to be thankful**, [[Luk.17.9|Luk.17:9]], [[1Ti.1.12|1Ti.1:12]], al.
3. Objectively, of the effect of grace,
(a) a state of **grace**: [[Rom.5.2|Rom.5:2]], [[2Ti.2.1|2Ti.2:1]], [[1Pe.5.12|1Pe.5:12]], [[2Pe.3.18|2Pe.3:18]];
(b) a proof or gift of **grace** (cl., **a favour**): [[Jhn.1.16|Jhn.1:16]], [[Act.6.8|Act.6:8]], [[Rom.1.5|Rom.1:5]], [[1Co.3.10|1Co.3:10]], [[2Co.9.8|2Co.9:8]], [[Gal.2.9|Gal.2:9]], [[Eph.3.2|Eph.3:2]], [[1Pe.5.5, 10|1Pe.5:5, 10]] al. (For fuller treatment of the NT usage, see AR, _Eph._, 221ff.; _DB_, ii, 254ff.; _DCG_, i, 686ff.; Cremer, see word).
(AS)

G5483.def:
**χαρίζομαι**
(χάρις), [in LXX: [[Est.8.7|Est.8:7]] (נָתַן), [[Sng.1.4|Sng.1:4]] א, [[Sir.12.3|Sir.12:3]], 2 -[[4Ma.9.1-32|4Ma.9:1-32]] * ;]
1. **to show favour or kindness**: with dative of person(s), [[Gal.3.18|Gal.3:18]]
2. **to give freely, bestow**: with accusative and dative, [[Luk.7.21|Luk.7:21]], [[Act.3.14; 25.11, 16; 27.24|Act.3:14 25:11, 16 27:24]], [[Rom.8.32|Rom.8:32]], [[1Co.2.12|1Co.2:12]], [[Php.1.29; 2.9|Php.1:29 2:9]], Phm 22.
3. In late Gk. (= Lat. condonare), **to grant forgiveness, forgive freely**: of debt, [[Luk.7.42-43|Luk.7:42-43]] (EGT, in l); of sin, [[2Co.2.7; 2.10; 12.13|2Co.2:7 2:10 12:13]], [[Eph.4.32|Eph.4:32]], [[Col.2.13; 3.13|Col.2:13 3:13]] (cf. _DB_, ii, 57a).†
(AS)

G5484.def:
therefore, because of this, for this reason
the acc. sg form of the noun χάριν which can be used as an _improper preposition_, **on account of, because of, for this reason** [[Luk.7.47|Lk. 7:47]]; [[Eph.3.1, 14|Eph. 3:1, 14]]; [[1Jn.3.12|1Jn. 3:12]] **for the sake of, in order to,** [[Gal.3.19|Gal. 3:19]] [[Tit.1.5, 11|Tit. 1:5, 11]]; Jude 16; **on the score of,** [[1Ti.5.14|1Tim. 5:14]]*

G5453.def:
**φύω**
[in LXX: [[Pro.26.9|Pro.26:9]], [[Ezk.37.8|Eze.37:8]] (עָלָה), etc. ;]
1. trans., to bring forth, produce (of men, to beget); pass., **to spring up, grow**: [[Luk.8.6|Luk.8:6]], 8.
2. Intrans., in 2 aor., pf., plpf., and rarely in present (see LS, see word, A, II.), **to spring up**: [[Heb.12.15|Heb.12:15]]†
(AS)

G5461.def:
**φωτίζω**
(φῶς) [in LXX for אוֹר hi, יָרָה hi., etc. ;]
1. intrans., **to shine, give light **(Arist., Plut., a1.): before ἐπί, [[Rev.22.5|Rev.22:5]]
2. Trans.
(a) **to illumine, enlighten **(Diod., Plut., al.): with accusative, [[Luk.11.36|Luk.11:36]], [[Rev.21.23|Rev.21:23]]; pass., [[Rev.18.1|Rev.18:1]] Metaphorical, of spiritual enlightenment ([[Psa.119.130|Psa.119:130]], [[Sir.45.17|Sir.45:17]], al.): [[Jhn.1.9|Jhn.1:9]], [[Eph.1.18; 3.9|Eph.1:18 3:9]], R, txt., [[Heb.6.4; 10.32|Heb.6:4 10:32]];
(b) **to bring to light, make known **(Polyb.): [[1Co.4.5|1Co.4:5]], [[Eph.3.9|Eph.3:9]], R, mg., [[2Ti.1.10|2Ti.1:10]] (cf. Kennedy, _Sources_, 107 f.).†
(AS)

G5421.def:
**φρέαρ**, -ατος, τό
[in LXX chiefly for בְּאֵר ;]
**a well**: [[Luk.14.5|Luk.14:5]], [[Sng.4.11-12|Sng.4:11-12]]; φ. τῆς ἀβύσσου, [[Rev.9.1-2|Rev.9:1-2]]†
(AS)

G5490.def:
**χάσμα**, -τος, τό
(χάσκω, to yawn), [in LXX: [[2Sa.18.17|2Ki.18:17]] (פַּחַת)* ;]
**a chasm, wide space**: [[Luk.16.26|Luk.16:26]]†
(AS)

G5482.def:
**χάραξ**, -ακος, ὁ
(χαράσσω), [in LXX for סֹלְלָה, מָצוֹר, etc. ;]
1. **a pointed stake **
2. **a palisade or rampart**: [[Luk.19.43|Luk.19:43]]†
(AS)

G5411.def:
**φόρος**, .-ου, ὁ
(φέρω), [in LXX chiefly for מַס, also for מִדָּה, etc. ;]
tribute paid by a subject nation (cf. [[1Ma.10.33|1Ma.10:33]]): φ. δοῦναι ([[1Ma.8.4|1Ma.8:4]] [[1Mac.8.7|1Mac 8:7]]), [[Luk.20.22; 23.2|Luk.20:22 23:2]]; ἀποδοῦναι, [[Rom.13.7|Rom.13:7]] τελεῖν, [[Rom.13.6|Rom.13:6]] (Hdt., al.).†
_SYN._: κῆνσος, τέλος (which see) (AS)

G5400.def:
**φόβητρον** (LTr., WH, -θρον), -ου, τό

**that which causes fright, a terror**: pl. (as always, exc.Isa, l.with), [[Luk.21.11|Luk.21:11]] (Hipp., Plat.).†
(AS)

G5404.def:
**Φοῖνιξ** (on the accent, see Bl., § 4, 2; WM, § 6, lc), -ικος, ὁ,
[in LXX for תָּמָר תִּמֹּר ;]
**the date palm, palm**: τὰ βαΐα τῶν φ., [[Jhn.12.13|Jhn.12:13]] of palm branches, φοίνικες (as Arist., [[2Ma.10.7|2Ma.10:7]], al.), [[Rev.7.9|Rev.7:9]].†
(AS)

G5493.def:
**χείμμαρος** (shortened form of the more usual -οος, Attic contr., -ους), -ον
(χεῖμα, ῥέω) [in LXX chiefly for נַחַל ;]
**winter-flowing**; as subst., ὁ χ. (sc. ποταμός), **a torrent**: [[Jhn.18.1|Jhn.18:1]]†
(AS)

G5435.def:
**φρυγία**, -ας, ἡ
(prop., the adj., Φρυγίος, -α, -ον; sc. γῆ, χώρα),
**Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor**: [[Act.2.10|Act.2:10]] Φ. καὶ Γαλατικὴ χώρα (Γ. χ. κ. Φ.), [[Act.16.6; 18.23|Act.16:6 18:23]] (on these phrases see _DB_, i, 89 f.; CGT, _Gal._, xxii f.).†
(AS)

G5433.def:
**φρυάσσω**
(so Ps, l.with, NT; elsewhere depon., φρυάσσομαι, Att.. -ττ-), [in LXX: [[Psa.2.1|Psa.2:1]] (רָגַשׁ), [[2Ma.7.34|2Ma.7:34]] R, [[3Ma.2.2|3Ma.2:2]] * ;]
prop., of horses, to neigh, whinny and prance (Plut., al.). Metaphorical, **to be wanton, insolent**: [[Act.4.25|Act.4:25]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G5441.def:
**φύλαξ**, -ακος, ὁ
(φυλάσσω), [in LXX for שָׁמַר, צוּר ;]
**a guard, keeper**: [[Act.5.23; 12.6, 19|Act.5:23 12:6, 19]].†
(AS)

G5488.def:
**χαρράν **
indecl. (in FlJ., _Ant._, i, 16, 1, Κάρρα, -ας, ib. 6, 5, Χαρρά, -ᾶς; so LXX: [[Gen.29.4|Gen.29:4]] E, [[Ezk.27.28|Eze.27:28]] B, elsewhere -άν­Heb. חָרָן), Haran, a town in N.W. Mesopotamia: [[Act.7.2|Act.7:2]], 4.†
(AS)

G5496.def:
**χειραγωγέω**, -ῶ
(χειραγωγός), [in LXX: [[Jdg.16.26|Jdg.16:26]] A (יָד חָזַק), [[Tob.11.16|Tob.11:16]] א * ;]
**to lead by the hand**: [[Act.9.8; 22.11|Act.9:8 22:11]].†
(AS)

G5497.def:
**χειρ-αγωγός**, -όν
(χείρ, ἄγω)
leading by the hand. As subst., ὁ χ., **one to lead by the head, a guide**: [[Act.13.11|Act.13:11]]†
(AS)

G5480.def:
**χάραγμα**, -τος, τό
(χαράσσω, to engrave),
(a) **a stamp, impress, mark**: [[Rev.13.16-17; 14.9, 11; 16.2; 19.20; 20.4|Rev.13:16-17 14:9, 11 16:2 19:20 20:4]] (see Deiss., BS, 240 ff.);
(b) **a thing graven**: [[Act.17.29|Act.17:29]]†
(AS)

G5405.def:
**φοῖνιξ**, -ικος, ο, ἡ
**Phænix, a city of Crete**: [[Act.27.12|Act.27:12]]†
(AS)

G5492.def:
**χειμάζω**
(χεῖμα, winter cold) [in LXX: [[Pro.26.10|Pro.26:10]] (†) * ;]
1. to expose to winter cold, go into winter quarters.
2. **to drive with storm**; pass., **to be driven with storm, tempest-tossed**: [[Act.27.18|Act.27:18]]†
(AS)

G5434.def:
**φρύγανον**, -ου, τό
(φρύγω, to parch), [in LXX chiefly for קַשׁ, also for חָרוּל, etc. ;]
**a dry stick**: pl., **brushwood**: [[Act.28.3|Act.28:3]]†
(AS)

G5410.def:
**φόρον**, -ου, τό
(Lat. forum): Ἀππίου Φ., see: Ἄππιος
(AS)

G5486.def:
**χάρισμα**, -τος, τό
(χαρίζομαι) [in LXX: [[Sir.7.33|Sir.7:33]] א (AB, χάρις) [[Sir.38.30|Sir.38:30]] Bl (א AB2R, χρῖσμα) * ;]
a gift of grace, a free gift, esp. of extra­ordinary operations of the Spirit in the Apostolic Church, but including all spiritual graces and endowments (Lft., _Notes_, 148 f.): [[Rom.1.11; 5.15-16; 6.23; 11.29; 12.6|Rom.1:11 5:15-16 6:23 11:29 12:6]], [[1Co.1.7; 7.7; 12.4; 12.9; 12.28; 12.30-31|1Co.1:7 7:7 12:4 12:9 12:28 12:30-31]], [[2Co.1.11|2Co.1:11]], [[1Ti.4.14|1Ti.4:14]], [[2Ti.1.6|2Ti.1:6]], [[1Pe.4.10|1Pe.4:10]].†
(AS)

G5446.def:
**φυσικός**, -ή, -όν
(ψύσις),
**natural **
(a) **produced by nature, innate **(Xen., Arist., al.);
(b) **according to nature **(Arist., Diod., al.): opposite to παρὰ φύσιν, [[Rom.1.26-27;|Rom.1:26-27]]
(with) **governed by mere natural instinct **(of. Plut., Mor., 706 A): ζῷα γεγεννημένα φ. (RV, born mere animals; Mayor, born creatures of instinct; _ICC_, animals born of mere nature), [[2Pe.2.12|2Pe.2:12]],†
(AS)

G5449.def:
**φύσις**, -εως, ἡ
(φύω) [in LXX: [[Wis.7.20; 13.1; 19.20|Wis.7:20 13:1 19:20]] אΑ, [[3Ma.3.29|3Ma.3:29]], [[4Ma.1.20|4Ma.1:20]] [[4Mac.5.7-8|4Mac 5:7-8]] [[4Mac.5.25|4Mac 5:25]] [[4Mac.13.27|4Mac 13:27]] [[4Mac.15.13|4Mac 15:13]] [[4Mac.15.25|4Mac 15:25]] [[4Mac.16.3|4Mac 16:3]] * ;]
nature, i.e.,
(a) the nature (natural powers or constitution) of a person or thing: [[Jas.3.7|Jas.3:7]], [[2Pe.1.4|2Pe.1:4]];
τέκνα φυσει ὀργῆς, [[Eph.2.3|Eph.2:3]]
(b) **origin, birth **(Soph., Xen., al.): [[Rom.2.27|Rom.2:27]], [[Gal.2.15|Gal.2:15]];
(with) nature, i.e. the regular order or law of nature: [[1Co.11.14|1Co.11:14]] dative, φύσει adverbially, by nature, [[Rom.2.14|Rom.2:14]], [[Gal.4.8|Gal.4:8]]; παρὰ φύσιν, against nature, [[Rom.1.26; 11.24|Rom.1:26 11:24]]; καρὰ φ., according to nature, naturally, [[Rom.11.21, 24|Rom.11:21, 24]].†
(AS)

G5420.def:
**φράσσω **
[in LXX: [[Job.38.8|Job.38:8]] (סָכַךְ hi.), [[Hos.2.6|Hos.2:6]](8) (שׂוּךְ), [[Pro.21.13|Pro.21:13]] (אָטַם), etc. ;]
**to fence in, stop, close**: στόματα λεόντων, [[Heb.11.33|Heb.11:33]] στόμα, metaphorically, [[Rom.3.19|Rom.3:19]] pass., καύχησις, [[2Co.11.10|2Co.11:10]]†
(AS)

G5427.def:
**φρόνημα**, -τος, τό
(φρονέω), [in LXX: [[2Ma.7.21|2Ma.7:21]] [[2Mac.13.9|2Mac 13:9]] * ;]
that which is in the mind (the content of φρονεῖν, _ICC_, Ro., 88), **the thought**: [[Rom.8.6-7, 27|Rom.8:6-7, 27]].†
(AS)

G5445.def:
**φύραμα**, -τος, τό
(φυράω, to mix), [in LXX: [[Exo.8.3|Exo.8:3]] ([[Exo.7.28|Exo.7:28]]) [[Exo.12.34|Exo.12:34]] (מִשְׁאֶרֶת), מִשְׁאֶרֶת), [[Num.15.20-21|Num.15:20-21]] (עֲרִיסָה) * ;]
**that which is mixed or kneaded, a lump**: of dough, [[Rom.11.16|Rom.11:16]], [[1Co.5.6-7|1Co.5:6-7]], [[Gal.5.9|Gal.5:9]]; of clay, [[Rom.9.21|Rom.9:21]]†
(AS)

G5448.def:
**φυσιόω**, -ῶ
(φῦσα, bellows), = cl. φυσάω,
to puff or blow up, inflate. Metaphorical, **to puff up, make proud**: [[1Co.8.1|1Co.8:1]] Pass., **to be puffed up with pride**: [[1Co.4.18-19; 5.2; 13.4|1Co.4:18-19 5:2 13:4]]; before ὑπό, [[Col.2.18|Col.2:18]] before ὑπὲρ . . . κατά, [[1Co.4.6|1Co.4:6]] (on the form of the subjc., see M, _Pr._, 54; Bl., § 22, 3).†
(AS)

G5424.def:
**φρήν ** genitive, φρενός, ἡ,
[in LXX most frequently in Pr ([[Pro.6.32|Pro.6:32]], al.) and chiefly for לֵב; also [[3Ma.4.16|3Ma.4:16]] [[3Mac.5.47|3Mac 5:47]] ;]
chiefly in Hom. and Trag., but also in Plat., al., both sing. and pl.;
1. in physical sense, the parts about the heart, midriff.
2. **heart, mind, thought**: pl., [[1Co.14.20|1Co.14:20]] (see Edwards, Eng.-_Gr._ _Lex._, _App._, 1).†
(AS)

G5415.def:
**φορτούνατος** (Rec. Φουρ-, see Mayser, 116 f.), -ου, ὁ
(Lat.) Fortunatus: [[1Co.16.17|1Co.16:17]] (see Lft., Cl. Ro., 1Co., 59).†
(AS)

G5432.def:
**φρουρέω**, -ῶ
(φρουρός, a guard), [in LXX: I [[Est.4.56|Est.4:56]], [[Jdt.3.6|Jdth.3:6]], [[Wis.17.16|Wis.17:16]], [[1Ma.11.3|1Ma.11:3]] * ;]
**to guard, keep under guard, protect or keep by guarding**: [[2Co.11.32|2Co.11:32]] metaphorically, [[Gal.3.23|Gal.3:23]], [[Php.4.7|Php.4:7]], [[1Pe.1.5|1Pe.1:5]].†
(AS)

G5450.def:
**φυσίωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(φυσιόω),
**a puffing up, swelling with pride**: pl., [[2Co.12.20|2Co.12:20]]†
(AS)

G5422.def:
**φρεν-απατάω**, -ῶ
(φρεναπάτης),
**to deceive one's mind **(Lft., deceive by fancies, see _Ga._, l.with): with accusative of person(s), [[Gal.6.3|Gal.6:3]]†
(AS)

G5458.def:
**φωστήρ**, -ῆρος, ὁ
(φῶς), [in LXX: [[Gen.1.14, 16|Gen.1:14, 16]] (מָאוֹר), Dan LXX 12:3 (זֹהַר), I [[Est.8.79|Est.8:79]], [[Wis.13.2|Wis.13:2]], [[Sir.43.7|Sir.43:7]] * ;]
**a luminary, light**: [[Php.2.15|Php.2:15]], [[Rev.21.11|Rev.21:11]].†
_SYN._: φέγγος, φῶς (AS)

G5498.def:
**χειρόγραφος**, -ον
(χείρ, γράφω), [in LXX: [[Tob.5.3; 9.2, 5|Tob.5:3 9:2, 5]] * ;]
written with the hand. As subst., τὸ χ., **a handwriting **(Inscr., Polyb., al.): metaphorically, [[Col.2.14|Col.2:14]]†
(AS)

G5471.def:
**χαλκεύς**, -έως, ὁ
(χαλκός), [in LXX for חָרָשׁ, etc. ;]
a worker, in metal, esp. a copper-smith: [[2Ti.4.14|2Ti.4:14]]†
(AS)

G5423.def:
**φρεναπάτης**, -ου, ὁ
(φρήν, ἀπάτη),
**a deceiver **(B1., deceiver of his own mind, § 28, 5.2, where see ref. to π.): [[Tit.1.10|Tit.1:10]] (eccl.).†
(AS)

G5431.def:
**φροντίζω**
(φροντίς, thought), [in LXX: [[1Sa.9.5|1Ki.9:5]] (דָּאַג), [[Psa.40.17|Psa.40:17]] (חָשַׁב), al. ;]
to give heed, take thought (in cl. usually absol., with accusative, with genitive), with inf., [[Tit.3.8|Tit.3:8]] (see Bl., § 69, 4; M, _Pr._, 206 f.).†
(AS)

G5481.def:
**χαρακτήρ**, -ῆρος, ὁ
(χαράσσω, to engrave), [in LXX: [[Lev.13.28|Lev.13:28]] (צָרֶבֶת), [[2Ma.4.10|2Ma.4:10]], [[4Ma.15.4|4Ma.15:4]] א R * ;]
1. a tool for graving.
2. **a stamp or impress**: as on a coin or seal; metaphorically, χ. τ. ὑποστάσεως, [[Heb.1.3|Heb.1:3]]†
(AS)

G5468.def:
**χαλιναγωγέω**, -ῶ
(χαλινός, ἄγω),
**to lead with a bridle**; metaphorically, **to bridle, restrain**: with accusative, γλῶσσαν, [[Jas.1.26|Jas.1:26]] σῶμα, [[Jas.3.2|Jas.3:2]]†
(AS)

G5425.def:
**φρίσσω**
(Att.. -ττω, and so [[4Ma.14.9|4Ma.14:9]] [[4Mac.17.7|4Mac 17:7]]) [in LXX: [[Job.4.15|Job.4:15]] ( pi.), etc. ;]
1. to be rough, bristle.
2. **to shiver, shudder, tremble, from fear**: [[Jas.2.19|Jas.2:19]] (see Hort, in l).†
(AS)

G5469.def:
**χαλινός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for מֶתֶג ;]
**a bridle**: [[Jas.3.3|Jas.3:3]], [[Rev.14.20|Rev.14:20]].†
(AS)

G5459.def:
**φωσ-φόρος**, -ον
(φῶς, φέρω),
**light-bringing**; as subst., ὁ φ., the morning star (Plat., al.; cf. ἐωσφόρος, [[Isa.14.12|Isa.14:12]], [[Job.3.9|Job.3:9]], [[Psa.110.3|Psa.110:3]]): metaphorically, [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]] (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G5489.def:
**χάρτης**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: [[Isa.8.1|Isa.8:1]] A, [[Jer.36.2, 6; 36.23|Jer.36:2, 6 36:23]] (מְגִלָּה) * ;]
**a sheet of paper, made of papyrus strips **(see Kennedy, _Sources_, 42; Milligan, _NTD_, 10-12; _DB_, iv, 945 f.): [[2Jn.12|II Jn 12]] (Plat., Inscr.).†
(AS)

G5474.def:
**χαλκο-λίβανον**, -ου, τό
**chalcolibanus, probably "a mixed metal of great brilliance" **(Swete): [[Rev.1.15; 2.18|Rev.1:15 2:18]] (RV, burnished brass).†
(AS)

G5470.def:
**χάλκεος**, -έα, -εον (-οῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν)
(χαλκός), [in LXX chiefly for נְחֹשֶׁת ;]
**brazen **(i.e. of copper): [[Rev.9.20|Rev.9:20]]†
(AS)

G5472.def:
**χαλκηδών**, -όνος, ὁ
**chalcedony, "supposed to denote a green silicate of copper found in the mines near Chalcedon " **(Swete): [[Rev.21.19|Rev.21:19]]†
(AS)
